l-e-m2-b03-09.title: Shin past form da past participle iri ɗaya ne?
l-e-m2-b03-09.goal: Gano ma'aunin (bayanin) da ake buƙata da gaske don bambanta kalmomin aiki waɗanda past form da past participle ɗinsu iri ɗaya ne da waɗanda suka bambanta, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓenka.
l-e-m2-b03-09.material: make - made - made / leave - left - left / eat - ate - eaten / take - took - taken. Raba kalmomin aikin nan huɗu zuwa rukuni biyu.
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s1.r.a: Make da take duka suna da haruffa 4, amma suna cikin rukuni dabam-dabam.
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s1.o.b: Ko past form da past participle suna da siga iri ɗaya
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s1.o.c: Ko tushen siga yana ƙarewa da e
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s1.r.c: Make da take suna ƙarewa da e, amma suna cikin rukuni dabam-dabam.
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s1.o.d: Ko past form yana ƙarewa da -ed
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s1.r.d: Babu ɗaya daga cikin kalmomin aikin huɗun da past form ɗinsa ke ƙarewa da -ed.
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s1.explain: Made - made da left - left suna da past form da past participle iri ɗaya, amma ate - eaten da took - taken sun bambanta.
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s2.model.0: Made da left suna da past form da past participle iri ɗaya, saboda haka suna zama rukuni ɗaya. Eaten da taken sun bambanta da past forms ɗinsu, saboda haka suna zama wani rukuni.
l-e-m2-b03-09.s.s2.model.1: Yawan haruffa ko harafin ƙarshe ba zai iya raba rukunonin biyu ba, saboda haka ma'aunin shi ne ko past form da past participle iri ɗaya ne.

l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.o.a: Bayan so yana zuwa sakamakon abin da ya gabata.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.o.b: Bayan so yana zuwa wani abu akasin abin da ya gabata.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.r.b: Stayed inside sakamakon ruwan sama ne, ba akasin sa ba.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.o.c: Kafin so yana zuwa sakamakon, bayansa kuma dalili.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.r.c: Dalilin ruwan sama yana zuwa kafin so.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.o.d: So yana nuna jerin lokaci ne kawai.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.r.d: So yana haɗa dalili da sakamako, ba jeri kawai ba.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s1.explain: An yi ruwan sama, saboda haka sun zauna a gida; sun gaji, saboda haka sun kwanta da wuri. Kafin so akwai dalili, bayan sa kuma sakamako.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: A jimloli ukun, ɓangaren kafin so shi ne dalili, bayan sa kuma sakamakonsa; saboda haka so yana gabatar da sakamako.
l-e-m2-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: Ana karantawa kamar sun zauna a gida saboda ruwan sama; saboda haka abin da ke zuwa bayan so sakamakon abin da ya gabata ne.

l-e-m2-b03-12.title: Ƙa'idar how to, where to, da what to
l-e-m2-b03-12.goal: Ka duba misalai da dama na ƙa'idar cewa to + asalin fi'ili yana zuwa bayan kalmar tambaya, ka faɗi ƙa'idar, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-m2-b03-12.material: I know how to swim. Do you know where to go? We don't know what to buy. Duba tsarin da ke zuwa bayan kalmar tambaya a jimlolin ukun.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.a: Bayan kalmar tambaya, ana amfani da fi'ili + -ing
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: Swim, go, da buy ba sigogin -ing ba ne.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.b: Kalmar tambaya + to + asalin fi'ili yana nufin 'abin da/yadda/inda za a yi ...'
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.c: Ana barin to da ke bayan kalmar tambaya
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Jimlolin ukun duk suna da to.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.d: Kalmar tambaya + to koyaushe yana nufin manufa
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: How to swim yana nufin yadda ake iyo, ba manufa ba.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.explain: How to swim yana nufin yadda za a iyo, where to go yana nufin inda za a je, kuma what to buy yana nufin abin da za a saya.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Dukkan jimlolin ukun suna da to + asalin fi'ili bayan kalmar tambaya, kuma suna magana ne kan hanya, wuri, ko abu; saboda haka ana iya ganin ƙa'idar.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: A sabuwar jimlar She knows when to leave, when to leave yana nufin lokacin da ya kamata ta tafi; saboda haka ƙa'idar ta tabbata.

l-e-m2-b04-12.material: I am good at drawing. We are afraid of failing. Thank you for helping. They talked about moving. Gano ƙa'idar daga misalan sannan ka yi amfani da ita a jimlar da ke ƙasa.
l-e-m2-b04-12.s.s1.prompt: We are tired of ___ for the bus. Wanne ne daidai?

l-e-m2-b04-13.title: Ƙa'idar yin tambayoyi a sigar karɓar aiki
l-e-m2-b04-13.goal: Dubi misalai da yawa na sauya jimlar karɓar aiki zuwa tambaya, bayyana ƙa'idar da ka gano, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon yanayi.
l-e-m2-b04-13.material: The cake was baked. → Was the cake baked? Rooms are cleaned. → Are rooms cleaned? The song is sung. → Is the song sung? Gano ƙa'idar sannan ka yi amfani da ita.
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.prompt: The windows were opened. → Wace tambaya ce daidai?
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.r.a: A tambayar sigar karɓar aiki, ana matsar da be verb zuwa gaba, ba did ba.
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.r.b: Dole ne mai jimla ya zo kai tsaye bayan be verb.
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: Windows jam'i ne, saboda haka were ake amfani da shi ba was ba.
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s1.explain: Matsar da be verb zuwa gaban mai jimla sannan a bar past participle yadda take. Jimlar ta zama Were the windows opened?
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: A misalan, be verb ya koma gaban mai jimla kuma past participle ta kasance yadda take, saboda haka jimlar ta zama Were the windows opened?
l-e-m2-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: Windows jam'i ne kuma jimlar tana baya, saboda haka were ne ke zuwa farko: Were the windows opened?

l-e-m2-b04-14.title: Ƙa'idar amfani da for da since
l-e-m2-b04-14.goal: Dubi misalai da yawa na for da since a present perfect, bayyana ƙa'idar da ka gano, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon yanayi.
l-e-m2-b04-14.material: We have lived here for three years. We have waited since 8 o'clock. We have studied for two hours. We have played since Monday. Gano ƙa'idar sannan ka yi amfani da ita.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.b: A present perfect, ana amfani da since don lokacin farawa, ba from ba.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.c: Bayan for tsawon lokaci ne ke zuwa, ba takamaiman lokaci kamar last summer ba.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.d: During ba kalma ce da ke nuna lokacin farawa ba.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.explain: A yi amfani da for kafin tsawon lokaci (three years), since kuma kafin lokacin da abu ya fara (8 o'clock, Monday).
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s2.model.0: A cikin misalan, an yi amfani da for kafin tsawon lokaci, since kuma kafin lokacin farawa, saboda haka a yi amfani da since kafin last summer.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s2.model.1: Last summer lokacin farawa ne, saboda haka since ya dace. An yi amfani da for ne kawai tare da tsawon lokaci.

l-e-m2-b04-15.title: Ƙa'idar past participle ta eaten da seen
l-e-m2-b04-15.goal: Dubi misalai da yawa na gano past participle na drive, bayyana ƙa'idar da ka gano sannan ka gwada ta da sabon yanayi.
l-e-m2-b04-15.material: eat → eaten, see → seen, take → taken, write → written. Have na zuwa gaban waɗannan past participle. Yi amfani da ƙa'idar misalan don yanke shawarar past participle na drive.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.prompt: I have ___ a bus before. Wanne ne daidai?
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.r.a: Sigar da aka saba ce da aka ƙara mata -ed. Misalan suna ƙarewa da -n.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.r.b: Drove sigar baya ce. Past participle ɗin misalan suna ƙarewa da -n.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.explain: Past participle ɗin misalan duk suna ƙarewa da -n ko -en. Sigar drive ita ma driven ce.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s2.model.0: Past participle ɗin misalan duk suna ƙarewa da -en, saboda haka driven ne daidai ga drive ma.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s2.model.1: Tana da sifar -en kamar eaten, taken, da written, saboda haka driven ne ke zuwa bayan have.

l-e-m2-b05-11.title: Dokar comparative na slowly da quickly
l-e-m2-b05-11.goal: Nemo kuma ka bayyana dokar daga misalai da dama na comparative na bayanai da suka ƙare da -ly, sannan ka gwada dokar da sabon misali.
l-e-m2-b05-11.material: slowly → more slowly, quickly → more quickly, carefully → more carefully. Nemo dokar daga misalan sannan ka yanke shawarar comparative na gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.prompt: Wane comparative ne ya dace da gently?
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.a: Gentle sifa ce. Misalan suna barin -ly yadda yake.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.b: Babu dokar ƙara -er a cikin misalan.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: Tare da bayanai masu -ly, ba a ƙara -ier. Ana saka more a gaba.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.explain: Bayanai masu ƙarewa da -ly suna samar da comparative ta saka more a gaba. Gently yana zama more gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: A cikin misalan, an saka more a gaban bayanin -ly; saboda haka gently ma yana zama more gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s2.model.1: Kamar yadda aka yi da slowly da quickly, a bar -ly sannan a yi amfani da more; saboda haka comparative na gently shi ne more gently.

l-e-m2-b05-12.title: Dokar It is ... for ... to
l-e-m2-b05-12.goal: Nemo kuma ka bayyana dokar tsarin “It is ... for (mutum) to ...” daga misalai da dama, sannan ka gwada dokar da sabon misali.
l-e-m2-b05-12.material: “It is easy for me to swim. It is hard for kids to wait. It is important for us to sleep.” Gano dokar daga misalan sannan ka yi amfani da ita ga jimlar da ke ƙasa.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.prompt: “It is fun ___ them to play.” Wace kalma ce ta dace?
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.r.a: A cikin misalan, for yana zuwa kafin mutum, ba of ba.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.r.b: With ba ya bayyana a cikin misalan.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.r.c: To ita ce kalmar da ke zuwa bayan mutum. Kafin mutum ana amfani da for.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s1.explain: Tsarin shi ne “It is (sifa) for (mutum) to (asalin fi'ili)”. Saka for kafin mutum.
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s2.model.0: A cikin misalan, for ta zo kafin mutum bayan sifa; saboda haka ya zama “It is fun for them to play.”
l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s2.model.1: Mutum yana zuwa bayan for, kamar easy for me da hard for kids; saboda haka for them ya dace.

l-e-m2-b05-14.material: “Has the bus left?” — “Yes, it has.” / “No, it hasn't.” “Have the kids arrived?” — “Yes, they have.” Gano dokar sannan ka yi amfani da ita ga jimlar da ke ƙasa.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.prompt: “Has the train arrived?” — “No, ___.” Wanne ya dace?
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.r.a: Ana amsa tambayar present perfect da has, ba did ba.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.r.b: Tare da it, ana amfani da has, ba have ba.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.r.d: Akwai jirgin ƙasa guda ɗaya, saboda haka it ake amfani da shi, ba they ba.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.explain: Maimaita has/have da ke cikin tambaya, sannan ka canza mai aikatawa zuwa wakilin suna kamar it ko they. “Has the train arrived?” → “No, it hasn't.”
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s2.model.0: A cikin misalan, an maimaita has na tambayar kuma an canza abu guda ɗaya zuwa it; saboda haka “No, it hasn't” daidai ne.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s2.model.1: Jirgin ƙasa guda ɗaya ne kuma tambayar tana farawa da has; saboda haka a ce it hasn't, ta amfani da hasn't.

l-e-m2-b05-15.goal: Nemo kuma ka bayyana dokar yadda nau'in amsa ke canzawa bisa kalmar tambaya daga misalai da dama, sannan ka gwada dokar da sabon misali.
